title: troia-ics: Provocation Testing for Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems — code and dataset
description: Code, container definitions, and full experimental record (40 main-matrix runs plus 104 binary-separation runs across three trigger classes: Class 1 n=20 per arm, Classes 2 and 3 n=16 per arm) accompanying the IEEE Access manuscript 'Pre-Deployment Provocation of Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems'. Includes the OpenPLC v3 program with the hidden contextual trigger, three observability collectors feeding four measurement channels, the Isolation Forest reference detector, the windowed 2-sigma and 3-sigma rule baselines, the ablation / cross-validation / seed-sensitivity / ROC-sweep analysis pipeline, the pre-registration document with its 2026-05-19 amendment, and all aggregated CSV and JSON summaries.
